ai_review.summary: Good‑sound recording of an energetic 1985 show highlighted by a fabulous Terrapin Station and smoking Crazy Fingers.
ai_review.review: The reviewer describes the performance as great, praising the first set and calling the second‑set opener “Women Are Smarter” a treat. Standout moments include Terrapin Station, Crazy Fingers, Throwing Stones/Turn On Your Love Light, and a superb vocal greeting from Jerry. The audio is noted simply as “good sound,” with no major technical complaints.
